nodes.author: CCSDMaskUp
nodes.text:
Worth noting here that Measles is ALSO a respiratory virus, and Colorado just reported its first case in two years.  

Read more about that instance here: https://t.co/xHYoCHSV26

nodes.author: CCSDMaskUp
nodes.text:
Colorado Wastewater holds mostly steady at low levels this week: 

Still only 3 utilities reporting "increasing" concentrations of COVID.  One of those (Aspen) is so high it's pushing the average up, but the median is quite flat. https://t.co/9XnOA9JK0N

nodes.author: CCSDMaskUp
nodes.text: The RSV Median however has really climbed though, after a nice dip in early March.  We may see more another uptick in rSV hospitalizations following this. https://t.co/8ClGj6nxWO

nodes.author: CCSDMaskUp
nodes.text:
To sum it all up? 

Worst flu season ever is still kicking, but it's lost a lot of its oomph. 

Flu has really dropped away (1/5th of peak)
COVID is at incredibly low levels, 
RSV is dropping, but is only down to about 1/2 its peak. 

Only RSV wastewater remains elevated. https://t.co/lhkF7vgIHL
